picks.editorial_note: A $4 billion advanced packaging plant is SK hynix's first U.S. HBM production hub, directly targeting the memory bottleneck constraining AI chip supply — a rare instance of AI-driven industrial investment landing at university-adjacent research infrastructure.
picks.title: SK hynix breaks ground on $4 billion advanced packaging production facility in Purdue Research Park

picks.editorial_note: The first live use of AI to assist a neurosurgeon in real time during brain tumor surgery marks a genuine clinical translation milestone, moving AI-assisted surgery from research demonstration to actual patient care.
picks.title: First patient in live AI-assisted sight-saving brain surgery

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $90 million commitment to three new Science and Technology Centers signals sustained federal prioritization of AI-adjacent fundamental research across robotics, biotech, and fusion at a moment of uncertain science funding.
picks.title: NSF launches three new Science and Technology Centers with $90M investment in transformative research

picks.editorial_note: Suchi Saria's recognition among TIME's 100 most influential people in AI is grounded in a concrete, deployed result: an FDA-cleared sepsis early warning system shown to cut mortality by 18%, one of the clearer real-world healthcare wins for AI this year.
picks.title: Hopkins engineer Suchi Saria among TIME's 100 most influential people in AI

picks.editorial_note: The revelation that AI can design entirely novel viral genomes not found in nature raises urgent biosecurity and dual-use questions that will shape how AI research is governed going forward.
picks.title: AI Can Now Create Viruses. Should We Let It? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: UT Austin's leadership of a new NSF center dedicated to human-robot co-adaptation reflects a substantial multi-institution bet on making assistive robots genuinely usable in everyday human environments.
picks.title: UT To Lead NSF Center That Will Study How Robots and People Learn To Live and Work Together - UT News
picks.university: The University of Texas at Austin

picks.editorial_note: UW's leadership role in DOE's Genesis Mission — a 300+ institution national AI-for-science initiative — illustrates how deeply AI is being embedded into the federal scientific research apparatus.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support 3 new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: Applying AI to search for singularities in the Navier-Stokes equations tackles a nearly 200-year-old open problem tied to a Millennium Prize question, a striking example of AI advancing the frontier of pure mathematics.
picks.title: From the Lab: How Javier Gómez-Serrano is using AI to solve the most elusive question in math

picks.editorial_note: The $30 million TEMPEST center's bid to predict and control turbulence combines simulation, theory, and AI in a way that could have broad downstream impact on aerospace, energy, and climate modeling.
picks.title: Can scientists predict—and control—turbulence?

picks.editorial_note: The $24.5 million National Data Platform project aims to build federated, AI-ready data infrastructure across institutions — unglamorous but foundational work that underpins future AI-driven science.
picks.title: Physics’ Coelho Lopes de Sa Joins $24.5 Million Effort to Create Unified, AI-Ready National Ecosystem | UMass Amherst
